touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Haxey qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST NICHOLAS and The Lady Mowbray Stone cross base, east of Church of St Nicholas. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Haxey: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Haxey offers CHURCH OF ST NICHOLAS, The Lady Mowbray Stone cross base, east of Church of St Nicholas, CHURCHYARD SUNDIAL APPROXIMATELY 25 METRES SOUTH EAST OF CHURCH OF ST NICHOLAS within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST NICHOLAS
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with CHURCH OF ST NICHOLAS and The Lady Mowbray Stone cross base, east of Church of St Nicholas, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
